entries.embedded_english: Ok…Move.
You heard the gaffer.  Lets go, Sharpe.
Infantry coming from the front sir!
What did I tell you! Now they know we're here! Everyone pull out NOW!
SNIPER! GET DOWN!!!
Hmm… Good question. Wait here, I'm going to find out
Hurry it up, Sharpe.  We don't have all night.
Sharpe! Take that Jerry sniper's rifle and deal with that patrol.
<whisper>Keep your head down, Sharpe.
<whisper> Theres a sniper in that window to the north west…
<whisper> These buggers usually work in pairs… but I can't see another one…
<whisper> Keep your eyes open
<whisper> You take 'em out and I'll signal Sarge
HALT!
<Quiet> Ok, Taylor is going to set the explosives.
Stick close…
<quiet> Jerry's been using Bastogne town square as a supply point for their armor units here.  That armor's the reason why the yanks are having such a hard time breaking through.
Looks like that’s the last of 'em!
Yeah! And tell 'im that we did the hard part for 'im!
Form up.  We're moving out.
<on radio>What's going on over there?!
<on radio>  So I said 'I'd Kill for some strudel, My rations don't even include chocolate!' I'm sick of crisp bread...
<harsh whisper> GET DOWN.
Private Davies, Seal that door! We don't want anyone following us!
Sir! The infantry from that convoy are heading for us!
Taylor's signalling something......Hell, there's somthing wrong with the detonators!  Sharpe, look lively.  You'll have to hit them with sniper rounds to set them off.
Excellent work for once, Taylor! Use 'em to take out the other tanks. Sharpe! You too. Don't worry about the ones under repair.  Fire only at the active Jerry panzers.
More approaching from the outside as well sir! South east!
Sir! Anti-armour infantry spotted down the alley to the south-east!

From everything we've seen so far, I'm guessing they had considered someone infiltrating in from this direction.   That means there might be more of them ahead, waiting for us.  Taylor, take Sharpe and scout ahead for snipers and spotters.
Spot on!
Stay alert, lads! This isn't over yet.
Damn it! Now they know we're here.  Push up to the windmill and engage them.
Wow! You're quite the marksman!
I want you to hold your fire until I give the order. Everything needs to go smoothly or we could end up with half the German army on our heads
<quiet>   Typical Jerry, always well prepared.  He's probably got enough ammo and fuel stacked up to keep him in business here for months.
Friendlies inbound sir!. Look like Fourth Armoured Division.
I didn't think we we’re going to make it out of there in once piece.
<quiet>  German convoy.  They must be heading to the supply point.
Looks like we've lost sight of that convoy. We're close to the front lines now, so the supply point can't be far off.
Uh-oh, looks like we've woke the neighbours.
Ok, Taylor is clear… Take the shot, Sharpe.
Yes Sir! C'mon Sharpe!
Sharpe! Cooper! Give them some backup!
Private Sharpe! Get to the top floor and get deal with that Jerry with the Panzerschreck!
Nice shooting Sharpe!
Private Sharpe! If you're that afraid of one little sniper use a smoke grenade and get to cover!
Hurry it up already Sharpe!
Quit Dawdling, Sharpe!
C'mon Buddy! We're short on time!
Private sharpe, Get in there and secure the windmill.   I don't want any suprises.
I think we've done enough damage for one day, lads! Let's leave something for the yanks to do.  Time to pull out!
Right! This is it…
You wait up here. I'll send Taylor down to set the explosives on one of those tanks. We'll begin the attack after they're detonated.

<quiet>  Not after we're through with him, Taylor. While the yank assault keeps Jerry busy, we're going to inflitrate in, take out their their forward outpost, then move on to the town square.  Everyone got it?  Right, then let's go.  Davies and Rogers are up already ahead, scouting the area.
Patton eh…?
I think we should be thanking ol' Sharpe-shooter here for that
<On radio>Outpost 1? Are you there? Hello?! Hello?!
Two more coming from the windmill, sir! Looks like we spooked 'em!
Taylor! Get that door open!
<whisper>We all clear?   Right, lets go.
<quiet>So what we do, Sarge? Flag them down and ask for directions?
Crafty Jerry so-and-so!   He's got this route well covered.
What are you waiting for Sharpe?!  A bloody invitation?  MOVE!
Cooper! Keep an eye out for enemy reinforcements! Private Sharpe - keep us covered!
Enemy reinforcements! They're coming over the wall to the north east!
INCOMING!
TIGER!   And bloody big it is, too! Over in the north corner!
Great shot!
Yeah! 'cause we're not afraid of 'im, not at all
<quiet>Hmm.  With that bomb damage, it looks like the main street is the only way for us to take. Let's go.
<quiet>… no, wait a moment…
<quiet>urgh, Jerry has some sentries up in that window to the north-west
<quiet>They're probably spotting for a Jerry sniper hiding somewhere out there.
<quiet>Looks like someone picked up a few tricks after Stalingrad…
<quiet>so it would seem… Sharpe, We'll handle them.  You find and kill that sniper.
Where do you suppose they're off to, then?
There's a patrol moving in at the far end!
<quiet>What's the situation, Private?
<quiet>Small patrol around the farmhouses in front of the windmill sir. Three at the front and at least one round the back.
<quiet>Anyone inside?
<quiet>…Can't be sure sir.  Rogers has gone ahead looking for a route in.
Ok. We're moving up to Rogers' position.  When he gives the signal we'll sneak past and jump the patrol.
Sharpe! Shoot the explosives!
oh my...! Sharpe! Are you alright?!
<quiet>…So what's the plan, Sarge?
Someone get on the line and tell them they took their damned time!
C'mon, the war's not going to fight itself.  Shift yourselves!
Dull conversation anyway...That should put the wind up 'em for a while!
<on radio>Outpost 1? Please respond!
Area's clear, Sarge.  looks like we got 'em all.
Oh for…
<quiet>We follow them. If we cut through this café then maybe we can find a way onto that street.
Sharpe! We're not going to last long in this situation. Get rid of that sniper!
Blimey! Good work, Sharpe!
<Quiet> Remember… Do not fire until I say otherwise!
SIR! We've secured a crate of Panzerschreks!
Sir! We got company entering the building from the east wall!
Where the hell did that panzerschreck come from?!
Sharpe, take out that tank NOW! Taylor, cover him!
